critical_code_review_comments: ads_rewarded.py: /quota uses GET (not POST). Original task spec said POST — confirm intent. Current GET implementation is correct REST and tests pass with GET. Update docs accordingly.

mall_v2.py /admin/products/bulk-import requires CSV column 'mrp_inr' not 'price_prc'. Document the column schema in the admin UI tooltip so admins don't hit the silent 'skipped: missing name or mrp_inr' branch.

account_deletion.py rejects 10-digit numbers starting with 9000 — Indian mobile validator may be too strict (real numbers do start with 90xx for several telcos). Recommend allowing all 6-9 first digit.

Routes /api/mall/products, /api/mall/v2/categories, /api/mall/v2/wishlist all return {success,...,items|products|categories} envelopes while some sibling endpoints (saver-progress, recently-viewed) return raw arrays/objects. Consider standardising response envelope shape across mall_v2 for client simplicity.
